_comment: OptiGob (single-target-year SIP) reference config for cross-validating OptiGob-ts's baseline. baseline_dairy_pop/baseline_beef_pop are in tens-of-thousands of head (OptiGob/INPUT_VARIABLES.md); 156.8/98.4 => ~1.57M dairy / ~0.98M beef, matching Ireland's 2020 herd. AR=5 matches OptiGob-ts's default so GHG is comparable. Only baseline-year outputs are read, so target_year and the scenario-only levers (abatement_scenario, forest/afforestation params, ratio, etc.) don't affect the comparison.
